✳ Lighthouse keeper story
  letter said, and enjoy a view of the trams.
  Marta read the letter twice, then placed it in the drawer with the logbooks.
  In October a fog rolled in from the south and stayed nine days. The foghorn groaned without
  pause, and most boats stayed tied in harbor. Tiago Rebelo's boat, the Santa Clara, was still
  out and three hours overdue.
  Marta lit the lamp at four and kept it burning through the dark hours. When the clockwork
  jammed, she turned the lens by hand, one heavy crank at a time. By midnight her wrists ached,
  and she kept turning.
  At dawn the fog thinned to gray, and a hull appeared, low and slow. Then a second hull appeared
  behind it, and both boats came home.
  The next morning Tiago climbed the 112 steps with a crate of sardines. He set it on the stone
  landing, said nothing, and nodded up at the lens.
  That week Marta mailed the ministry her answer on the back of its own letter: Not yet.
